# 1 Samuel Chapter 25 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 164v-165v | **Source Image:** 1SA_025_page_001.jpg, 1SA_025_page_002.jpg, 1SA_025_page_003.jpg

---

**25:1** And-died Shemu'el (Samuel), and-gathered-together all Yisra'el (Israel), and-they-mourned for-him, and-they-buried him in-his-house in-Ramah (the-height). And-arose David, and-he-went-down to [the]-wilderness of-Pa'ran (Paran).

**25:2** And-[there was] a-man in-Ma'on (habitation), and-his-work [was] in-Karmel (Carmel), and-the-man [was] very great, and-to-him [were] three thousand sheep and-a-thousand goats. And-he-was shearing his-sheep in-Karmel (Carmel).

**25:3** And-[the]-name of-the-man [was] Naval (Nabal -- fool), and-[the]-name of-his-wife [was] Avigayil (Abigail -- father-of-joy), and-the-woman [was] good of-understanding and-beautiful of-form. And-the-man [was] hard and-evil of-deeds, and-he [was] a-Kalevite (Calebite).

**25:4** And-heard David in-the-wilderness that Naval (Nabal) [was] shearing his-sheep.

**25:5** And-sent David ten young-men, and-said David to-the-young-men, "Go-up to-Karmel (Carmel), and-you-shall-come to Naval (Nabal), and-you-shall-ask to-him in-my-name for-peace.

**25:6** And-you-shall-say thus: 'To-the-living [one]! And-you -- peace, and-your-house -- peace, and-all which [is] to-you -- peace.

**25:7** And-now, I-have-heard that [there are] shearers to-you. Now, the-shepherds who [were] to-you were with-us; we-did-not-shame them, and-not was-missing to-them anything, all [the]-days of-their-being in-Karmel (Carmel).

**25:8** Ask your-young-men, and-they-will-tell to-you. And-let-find the-young-men favor in-your-eyes, for upon a-day of-goodness we-have-come. Give, please, whatever finds your-hand, to-your-servants and-to-your-son, to-David.'"

**25:9** And-came [the]-young-men of-David, and-they-spoke to Naval (Nabal) according-to-all the-words the-these in-[the]-name of-David. And-they-rested.

**25:10** And-answered Naval (Nabal) the-servants of-David, and-he-said, "Who [is] David? And-who [is] [the]-son of-Yishai (Jesse)? Today have-multiplied servants who-break-away, each from-before his-master.

**25:11** And-shall-I-take my-bread and-my-water and-my-slaughtered-meat which I-have-slaughtered for-my-shearers, and-give [it] to-men whom I-do-not-know from-where they [are]?"

**25:12** And-turned [the]-young-men of-David to-their-way, and-they-returned, and-they-came and-they-told to-him according-to-all the-words the-these.

**25:13** And-said David to-his-men, "Gird, each, his-sword!" And-they-girded, each, his-sword, and-girded also David his-sword. And-went-up after David about four hundred man, and-two-hundred sat by the-equipment.

**25:14** And-to-Avigayil (Abigail), [the]-wife of-Naval (Nabal), told one young-man from-the-young-men, saying, "Behold, sent David messengers from-the-wilderness to-bless our-master, and-he-flew-at them.

**25:15** And-the-men [were] good to-us exceedingly, and-we-were-not shamed, and-we-did-not-miss anything all [the]-days we-walked with-them in-our-being in-the-field.

**25:16** A-wall they-were upon-us, both by-night and-also by-day, all [the]-days of-our-being with-them, shepherding the-flock.

**25:17** And-now, know and-see what you-will-do, for completed [is] the-evil against our-master and-against all his-house. And-he [is] a-son of-Beliyya'al (worthlessness), [too wicked] to-speak to-him."

**25:18** And-hurried Avigayil (Abigail), and-she-took two-hundred bread[s] and-two skins of-wine and-five sheep made [ready] and-five se'ahs (measures) of-roasted-grain and-a-hundred clusters-of-raisins and-two-hundred cakes-of-figs, and-she-put [them] upon the-donkeys.

**25:19** And-she-said to-her-young-men, "Pass-over before-me; behold-me, after-you [I am] coming." And-to-her-husband Naval (Nabal) she-did-not tell.

**25:20** And-it-was, she [was] riding upon the-donkey and-going-down in-[the]-cover of-the-mountain, and-behold, David and-his-men [were] going-down to-meet her, and-she-met them.

**25:21** And-David had-said, "Surely for-nothing I-guarded all which [was] to-this [one] in-the-wilderness, and-not was-missing from-all which [was] to-him anything, and-he-returned to-me evil in-place-of good.

**25:22** Thus may-do God to-[the]-enemies of-David and-thus may-He-add, if I-leave from-all which [is] to-him until the-morning one-who-urinates against-a-wall."

**25:23** And-saw Avigayil (Abigail) David, and-she-hurried, and-she-got-down from-upon the-donkey, and-she-fell before David upon her-face, and-she-bowed-down to-the-ground.

**25:24** And-she-fell upon his-feet, and-she-said, "On-me, my-lord, the-iniquity! And-let-speak, please, your-maidservant in-your-ears, and-hear the-words of-your-maidservant.

**25:25** Let-not, please, set my-lord his-heart upon the-man of-the-Beliyya'al (worthlessness) the-this, upon Naval (Nabal), for as-his-name, so [is] he -- Naval (fool) [is] his-name, and-foolishness [is] with-him. And-I, your-maidservant, did-not see the-young-men of-my-lord whom you-sent.

**25:26** And-now, my-lord, [by the]-life of-YHWH and-[by the]-life of-your-soul, who has-restrained you YHWH from-coming in-blood[shed] and-delivering your-hand to-you -- and-now, let-them-be as-Naval (Nabal), your-enemies and-the-ones-seeking against my-lord evil.

**25:27** And-now, the-blessing the-this which has-brought your-maidservant to-my-lord -- and-it-shall-be-given to-the-young-men, the-ones-walking at-[the]-feet of-my-lord.

**25:28** Forgive, please, the-transgression of-your-maidservant, for making, YHWH-will-make for-my-lord a-house enduring, for [the]-battles of-YHWH my-lord [is] fighting, and-evil shall-not be-found in-you from-your-days.

**25:29** And-shall-rise a-man to-pursue you and-to-seek your-soul, and-shall-be [the]-soul of-my-lord bound in-[the]-bundle of-the-living with YHWH your-God, and the-soul of-your-enemies He-shall-sling-them in-[the]-midst of-[the]-hollow of-the-sling.

**25:30** And-it-shall-be, when does YHWH to-my-lord according-to-all which He-has-spoken the-good concerning-you, and-He-commands you for-ruler over Yisra'el (Israel),

**25:31** and-not shall-be this to-you for-a-stumbling and-for-a-stumbling-block of-heart to-my-lord, and-to-shed blood without-cause, and-for-my-lord to-deliver [by] his-own-hand. And-shall-do-good YHWH to-my-lord, and-you-shall-remember your-maidservant."

**25:32** And-said David to-Avigayil (Abigail), "Blessed [is] YHWH, God of-Yisra'el (Israel), who sent-you the-day the-this to-meet me.

**25:33** And-blessed [is] your-discernment, and-blessed [are] you who have-restrained me the-day the-this from-coming in-blood[shed] and-delivering my-hand to-me.

**25:34** And-yet, [by the]-life of-YHWH, God of-Yisra'el (Israel), who has-restrained me from-doing-evil to-you -- for if not you-had-hurried, and-you-came to-meet me, surely not would-have-been-left to-Naval (Nabal) until [the]-light of-the-morning one-who-urinates against-a-wall."

**25:35** And-received David from-her-hand that-which she-brought to-him, and-to-her he-said, "Go-up in-peace to-your-house. See, I-have-listened to-your-voice, and-I-have-lifted your-face."

**25:36** And-came Avigayil (Abigail) to Naval (Nabal), and-behold, to-him [was] a-feast in-his-house like-[the]-feast of-the-king. And-[the]-heart of-Naval (Nabal) [was] good upon-him, and-he [was] drunk exceedingly. And-she-did-not-tell to-him a-thing, small or great, until [the]-light of-the-morning.

**25:37** And-it-was in-the-morning, when-went-out the-wine from-Naval (Nabal), and-told to-him his-wife the-things the-these, and-died his-heart within-him, and-he became like-a-stone.

**25:38** And-it-was about ten days, and-struck YHWH Naval (Nabal), and-he-died.

**25:39** And-heard David that had-died Naval (Nabal), and-he-said, "Blessed [is] YHWH who has-contended the-contention of-my-reproach from-[the]-hand of-Naval (Nabal), and his-servant He-has-restrained from-evil, and the-evil of-Naval (Nabal) YHWH-has-returned upon-his-[own]-head." And-sent David, and-he-spoke with-Avigayil (Abigail) to-take her to-him for-a-wife.

**25:40** And-came [the]-servants of-David to Avigayil (Abigail) to-Karmel (Carmel), and-they-spoke to-her, saying, "David has-sent us to-you, to-take you to-him for-a-wife."

**25:41** And-she-arose, and-she-bowed-down [with her]-face to-the-ground, and-she-said, "Behold, your-maidservant [is] for-a-servant, to-wash [the]-feet of-[the]-servants of-my-lord."

**25:42** And-hurried and-arose Avigayil (Abigail), and-she-rode upon the-donkey and-five of-her-young-women, the-ones-walking at-her-foot, and-she-went after [the]-messengers of-David, and-she-became to-him for-a-wife.

**25:43** And-Achino'am (Ahinoam) took David from-Yizre'el (Jezreel), and-they-were, also [the]-two-of-them, to-him for-wives.

**25:44** And-Sha'ul (Saul) had-given Mikhal (Michal) his-daughter, [the]-wife of-David, to-Palti (Palti) son of-Layish (Laish), who [was] from Gallim (Gallim).

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **25:1** -- The Leningrad Codex reads "Pa'ran" (פארן) for the wilderness. Some manuscripts and the LXX read "Ma'on" (מעון), which would better fit the geographical context of the subsequent narrative. The MT reading is preserved here.

2. **25:3** -- "Kalevite" (כלבי) -- literally "a Calebite," i.e., a descendant of Caleb. The word-play with כלב (kelev, "dog") may be intentional given Nabal's character portrayal.

3. **25:22** -- The Leningrad Codex reads "to-the-enemies of-David" (לאיבי דוד), a scribal euphemism (tiqqun soferim) substituted for "to David" to avoid David cursing himself.

4. **25:26** -- The syntax is difficult. "Delivering your-hand to-you" (והושע ידך לך) appears to mean "saving yourself by your own hand."

5. **25:29** -- "Bundle of-the-living" (צרור החיים) -- a metaphor for divine protection; the soul is kept safe as precious items in a pouch.

6. **25:34** -- The ketiv/qere distinction: the oath formula here mirrors v. 22.

7. **25:44** -- "Palti" (פלטי) is elsewhere called "Paltiel" (פלטיאל) in 2 Samuel 3:15.

-- EMET
